newsitem.title: USA: CompUSA to offer build-to-order PCs.
newsitem.headline: CompUSA to offer build-to-order PCs.

text.p: CompUSA Inc said Tuesday it plans to enter the build-to-order personal computer business with the launch of a full line of desktop computers early this fall.

"Build-to-order PCs is one of the greatest areas of opportunity in our industry today and CompUSA is uniquely positioned to attract customers who desire the highest quality products at aggressive prices," Jim Halpin, CompUSA president and chief executive, said in a press release.
The retail chain said it also would offer technical service and training in its 130 superstores.

The company said its new personal computers will range from state-of-the-art models to value-priced models. Intel Corp's Pentium processors and components will be available and the computers will be assembled by various third-party manufacturers, the company said.
Customers will be able to place their customized orders through the CompUSA web site, direct mail orders, CompUSA's corporate sales and in the superstores.
